messages.content: Write a short announcement for a new feature in a note-taking app: offline sync. Around 200 words.

# Offline Sync is Here

You can now work on your notes without an internet connection. Changes save locally on your device and sync automatically when you're back online—no manual action needed.

This means you can open your notes anywhere: on a flight, in a subway, or anywhere you lose signal. Your notes stay accessible. When your connection returns, your edits merge seamlessly with updates from other devices.

**How it works:**

Your device keeps a full copy of your notes, encrypted the same way your cloud storage is. When you edit offline, the app records those changes. Once you connect, it compares your local version with the server and syncs both directions. If you made edits on two devices at once, we keep all changes—nothing gets lost.

**Try it now:**

Turn off your WiFi or use airplane mode. Open the app, edit a note, and close it. Reconnect and check another device—your changes are there. If you're on our free plan, you get offline access to 100 recent notes. Subscribers get full offline support for your entire vault.

We built this for people who write everywhere. Your ideas shouldn't wait for a connection.
